sources.title: Google Street View, 18 Nevill Street opposite Empire
sources.use: Current front, rounded corner, windows, signage and neighbour gap; heading 218–245 degrees.

sources.title: VR360TV panorama, Nevill Street
sources.use: Full front and central gable seen from farther along the street.

sources.title: Google actual 3D orbit around Empire
sources.use: Four cardinal oblique rotations: red tiled hip, rooflights, rear upper windows and neighbouring roofs. Copyright year is not an imagery date.

sources.title: Google flat overhead with four coordinate controls
sources.use: Roof proportions and passage. Elevated photogrammetric roof location cannot override shared neighbour datum without a block survey.

sources.title: Neville Buildings architectural drawing
sources.credit: Lancashire Archives, reproduced by Southport BID
sources.use: Clarifies seven lower and five upper window axes and mouldings. Historical corner spire and shopfront are not current. Current capped stacks are evidenced separately by close 3D imagery.

sources.title: Food Standards Agency Empire entry
sources.use: Current address 11–13 Nevill Street; not geometric evidence.

sources.title: Sefton Townscape Heritage target buildings
sources.use: 11–13 Nevill Street identified as Neville Buildings.

sources.title: Nearby Mapillary image
sources.use: Actually loaded and viewed, but faces opposite Bistrot Pierre. Not used to invent Empire rear details.

sources.title: Attempt to find a Cable Street rear view
sources.use: Resolved to Ship & Anchor private courtyard panorama. Viewed, but wrong building and excluded from Empire modelling.

sources.title: Close current central gable and curved corner
sources.use: Confirmed infilled historical gable window, surviving low sash, stone bands, curved corner window surrounds and sagging upper ironwork.

sources.title: Close Google 3D roof orbit and overhead
sources.use: Four close oblique headings resolve small hip plateau, long front pitched hood, four capped stacks, two side rooflights, five rear roof windows and pale rear masonry. Wider block orbit was insufficient for these details.

sources.title: Actual 3D roof recheck from rear and passage side
sources.use: Actual GPU-rendered imagery inspected and orbited; confirms hip/plateau and returning roof arrangement. Close prior orbit/overhead captures re-examined for ridge endpoints. Zoom controls repeatedly entered Street View at 85a, so finer junction measurements use saved close captures; no claim that current 85a imagery resolves flashing.

sources.title: Google Street View, close passage gate
sources.use: Closed weathered double gate, mesh panels and upper vertical metal grille; proportions estimated.

rights: Links and descriptive observations only. Captures private outside Git. Textures and geometry independently authored; source imagery is not redistributed.
